title: The Secret Cartel Behind The Swarm — Part 1

cuts.voiceover_text: In an underground bunker inside NGL, cartel guards scramble as monstrous beasts break through. The centaur ant Yunju guns down the traffickers without hesitation. These men thought their illicit drug operation was untouchable, but they have just become food.
Miles away, Gon, Killua, and Kite speed toward the border. Kite explains that the mutant queen consumes humans to birth hybrid soldiers. If they fail to stop her, the continent will fall.

Behind NGL's pristine green borders, Gyro ran an underground syndicate mass-producing the deadly narcotic D-2. The ants drag the dead bosses away, leaving the hunters to walk into an empire already overrun.

series.summary: Chimera Ants slaughter an armed narcotics syndicate inside NGL, exposing the sinister underworld hidden beneath the country's peaceful eco-friendly borders.
